law: THE CANONICAL SHEET LAW. One canonical image per character -- the best existing, left untouched. Every other pose keeps its ACCEPTED BODY (keyed silhouette, plate-pulled palette, measured baseline, twin alignment) and receives the canonical HEAD by i2i graft. Alpha is never taken from a generation, so no regeneration can move a figure, change a baseline, break a strip cell or unalign a twin pair.

holmes.why: the only Holmes face in the book that is a lean hawk-faced man of ~35 and not an old peasant; matches cameo/holmes.jpg in bone structure
holmes.face: gaunt, long straight aquiline nose, deep-set eyes under heavy dark straight brows, hollow cheeks, thin firm mouth, DARK BROWN-BLACK hair, CLEAN SHAVEN

irene.why: shipped, drawn in Beat VI (the reveal), accepted; the only Irene whose eyes are painted
irene.hair: near-black and COOL -- clusters #1B1928 / #1F2736 / #30323C, every hair facet has B >= R

norton.why: already consistent across all five poses; no drift found

king.why: the published unmasked face; the exit walk now matches it
